meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作描述生成可部署的 Azure 基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 基础设施的规划与搭建,想直接从业务描述生成可部署代码。
copy.tagline_en: Generate deployable Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a cloud architect who wants to generate Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.

howto.what: 按你的工作负载描述，分七个阶段规划 Azure 企业基础设施：先产出计划 JSON，经你批准后生成 Bicep 或 Terraform 代码，本地校验通过才部署。
howto.when: 当你要求规划 Azure 基础设施、landing zone 或多区域容灾拓扑时触发；面向应用的工作负载建议改用 azure-prepare。

say.text: 帮我规划一套 hub-spoke 网络，含 VNet、防火墙和私有终结点
say.note: 先出计划，等你批准后再生成代码

say.text: 为这个工作负载设计多区域容灾拓扑，并生成 Bicep
say.note: 校验通过后才提示部署确认

say.text: 基于已有的资源组规划新工作负载，只做增量部署
say.note: 已有资源只被引用，不会重建

howto.what_en: From a workload description, Claude runs a 7-phase gated pipeline to plan enterprise Azure infrastructure, writes a plan JSON, then generates Bicep or Terraform that must pass validation before an approved deploy.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to plan Azure infrastructure, a landing zone, or multi-region DR topologies; for app-centric workflows it points to azure-prepare.

say_en.text: Plan a hub-spoke network with VNets, firewalls and private endpoints
say_en.note: Produces a plan first, waits for your approval

say_en.text: Design a multi-region DR topology for this workload and generate Bicep
say_en.note: Asks for deploy confirmation after validation

say_en.text: Plan a new workload on my existing resource group, additive only
say_en.note: Existing resources are referenced, never recreated
